name: svg-hand-drawn-preview
title_zh: 把任意 SVG 变成手绘动画演示包
tagline_zh: 丢一个 SVG 文件或链接，拿回独立 preview.html + 可复用 player.js。
tagline_en: Drop an SVG file or URL, get a standalone preview.html plus a reusable player.js. Strokes and fills draw.
desc_en: Generate a hand-drawn SVG animation package from a local SVG file or SVG URL. Use when the user wants an SVG drawing demo with path-plus-fill animation, or wants the default deliverables to be a standalone preview.html plus a reusable player.js.
why_zh: 不依赖在线服务，本地生成；动画逻辑封装成 player.js，可嵌入任意页面；路径与填充分轨处理。
why_en: Runs fully offline; the animation logic ships as a reusable player.js for any page; paths and fills are animated on separate.
limit_zh: 只接受单层、无外部引用的 SVG；渐变/滤镜/蒙版会被降级为纯色；动画时长固定 3 秒，不提供逐路径调速。
limit_en: Single-layer SVG only, no external refs; gradients/filters/masks flatten to solid fills; fixed 3s duration, no per-path timing; outputs HTML+JS.
